SELECT
    f.delay_bucket,
    v.transportationType,
    COUNT(*) AS records_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.vehicle_key) AS vehicles_count
FROM live_transit_monitor.fact_vehicle_status f
LEFT JOIN live_transit_monitor.dim_vehicle v
    ON f.vehicle_key = v.vehicle_key
WHERE v.transportationType IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    f.delay_bucket,
    v.transportationType

SELECT route_short_name, transportationType, avg_delay_min, active_vehicles
FROM (
    SELECT
        route_short_name,
        transportationType,
        ROUND(AVG(delay_min), 2) AS avg_delay_min,
        COUNT(DISTINCT vehicleId) AS active_vehicles,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY transportationType
            ORDER BY AVG(delay_min) DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM live_transit_monitor.gold_fleet_current
    GROUP BY route_short_name, transportationType
    HAVING transportationType IS NOT NULL
)
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY avg_delay_min DESC

SELECT route_short_name, transportationType, avg_speed, active_vehicles
FROM (
    SELECT
        route_short_name,
        transportationType,
        ROUND(AVG(speed), 2) AS avg_speed,
        COUNT(DISTINCT vehicleId) AS active_vehicles,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY transportationType
            ORDER BY AVG(speed) ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM live_transit_monitor.gold_fleet_current
    WHERE is_moving = true
    GROUP BY route_short_name, transportationType
    HAVING transportationType IS NOT NULL
)
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY avg_speed ASC

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT vehicleId) AS active_vehicles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_moving = false THEN vehicleId END) AS stopped_vehicles,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN delay > 120 THEN vehicleId END) AS delayed_vehicles,
    ROUND(AVG(delay_min), 2) AS avg_delay_min,
    transportationType
FROM live_transit_monitor.gold_fleet_current
GROUP BY transportationType
HAVING transportationType IS NOT NULL

SELECT
    headsign,
    active_vehicles,
    transportationType
FROM (
    SELECT
        d.headsign,
        v.transportationType,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.vehicle_key) AS active_vehicles,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY v.transportationType
            ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT f.vehicle_key) DESC
        ) AS rn

    FROM live_transit_monitor.fact_vehicle_status f

    LEFT JOIN live_transit_monitor.dim_destination d
        ON f.destination_key = d.destination_key

    LEFT JOIN live_transit_monitor.dim_vehicle v
        ON f.vehicle_key = v.vehicle_key

    WHERE v.transportationType IS NOT NULL

    GROUP BY
        d.headsign,
        v.transportationType
)
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY active_vehicles DESC

SELECT
    route_short_name,
    transportationType,
    active_vehicles,
    delayed_vehicles,
    ROUND(delayed_vehicles * 100.0 / active_vehicles, 1) AS pct_delayed,
    avg_delay_min,
    max_delay_min,
    ROUND((delayed_vehicles * 100.0 / active_vehicles) * avg_delay_min, 1) AS problem_score
FROM live_transit_monitor.gold_route_summary
WHERE active_vehicles >= 5 AND transportationType is not null
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY transportationType
    ORDER BY (delayed_vehicles * 100.0 / active_vehicles) * avg_delay_min DESC
) <= 10
ORDER BY problem_score DESC

    MAX(delay_min) AS max_delay_min,
    CONCAT(MAX_BY(route_short_name, delay_min), ' (', transportationType, ')') AS route_info,
    transportationType
FROM live_transit_monitor.gold_fleet_current
WHERE delay_min IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY transportationType
HAVING transportationType IS NOT NULL

SELECT vehicleCode, route_short_name, headsign, delay_min, speed, event_time_local, transportationType
FROM (
    SELECT
        vehicleCode,
        route_short_name,
        headsign,
        delay_min,
        speed,
        event_time_local,
        transportationType,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY transportationType
            ORDER BY delay_min DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM live_transit_monitor.gold_fleet_current
    WHERE delay_min IS NOT NULL AND transportationType is not null
)
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY delay_min DESC

SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('hour', f.event_time_local) AS hour_bucket,
    v.transportationType,
    ROUND(AVG(f.delay_min), 2) AS avg_delay_min,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.vehicleId) AS active_vehicles
FROM live_transit_monitor.fact_vehicle_status f

LEFT JOIN live_transit_monitor.dim_vehicle v
    ON f.vehicle_key = v.vehicle_key

WHERE f.has_trip = true
  AND v.transportationType IS NOT NULL

GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('hour', f.event_time_local),
    v.transportationType

ORDER BY hour_bucket

SELECT
    route_short_name,
    transportationType,
    avg_delay_min,
    on_time_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        r.route_short_name,
        v.transportationType,

        ROUND(AVG(f.delay_min), 2) AS avg_delay_min,

        ROUND(
            100.0 * SUM(
                CASE WHEN f.delay_bucket = 'on_time'
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            ) / COUNT(*),
            2
        ) AS on_time_pct,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY v.transportationType
            ORDER BY
                (
                    100.0 * SUM(
                        CASE WHEN f.delay_bucket = 'on_time'
                        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                    ) / COUNT(*)
                ) DESC
        ) AS rn

    FROM live_transit_monitor.fact_vehicle_status f

    LEFT JOIN live_transit_monitor.dim_route r
        ON f.route_key = r.route_key

    LEFT JOIN live_transit_monitor.dim_vehicle v
        ON f.vehicle_key = v.vehicle_key

    WHERE f.has_trip = true
      AND r.route_short_name IS NOT NULL
      AND v.transportationType IS NOT NULL

    GROUP BY
        r.route_short_name,
        v.transportationType

    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
)

WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY transportationType, on_time_pct DESC

WITH route_stats AS (
    SELECT
        r.route_short_name,
        v.transportationType,
        ROUND(AVG(f.delay_min), 2) AS avg_delay_min,
        ROUND(
            100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.is_delayed = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            / COUNT(*),
            2
        ) AS delayed_pct

    FROM live_transit_monitor.fact_vehicle_status f

    LEFT JOIN live_transit_monitor.dim_route r
        ON f.route_key = r.route_key

    LEFT JOIN live_transit_monitor.dim_vehicle v
        ON f.vehicle_key = v.vehicle_key

    WHERE f.has_trip = true
      AND r.route_short_name IS NOT NULL
      AND v.transportationType IS NOT NULL

    GROUP BY
        r.route_short_name,
        v.transportationType

    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
)

SELECT
    route_short_name,
    transportationType,
    avg_delay_min,
    delayed_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY transportationType
            ORDER BY avg_delay_min DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM route_stats
)
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY transportationType, avg_delay_min DESC

WITH accessibility AS (
    SELECT 
        transportationType,

        ROUND(
            100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN wheelchairsRamp = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            / COUNT(*), 1
        ) AS wheelchair_accessible,

        ROUND(
            100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN airConditioning = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            / COUNT(*), 1
        ) AS air_conditioning,

        ROUND(
            100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN usb = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            / COUNT(*), 1
        ) AS usb,

        ROUND(
            100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ticketMachine = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            / COUNT(*), 1
        ) AS ticket_machine

    FROM live_transit_monitor.dim_vehicle
    WHERE transportationType IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY transportationType
)

SELECT
    transportationType,
    feature,
    percentage
FROM accessibility
LATERAL VIEW STACK(
    4,
    'Wheelchair accessible', wheelchair_accessible,
    'Air conditioning', air_conditioning,
    'USB', usb,
    'Ticket machine', ticket_machine
) AS feature, percentage

SELECT
    r.route_short_name AS route,
    v.transportationType,
    ROUND(AVG(f.delay_min), 2) AS avg_delay_min,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.vehicle_key) AS active_vehicles,
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(f.delay_min) <= 2 THEN 'On time'
        WHEN AVG(f.delay_min) <= 5 THEN 'Minor delays'
        ELSE 'Major delays'
    END AS service_status
FROM live_transit_monitor.fact_vehicle_status f
LEFT JOIN live_transit_monitor.dim_route r
    ON f.route_key = r.route_key
LEFT JOIN live_transit_monitor.dim_vehicle v
    ON f.vehicle_key = v.vehicle_key
WHERE f.has_trip = true
  AND r.route_short_name IS NOT NULL
  AND v.transportationType IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    r.route_short_name,
    v.transportationType
ORDER BY avg_delay_min DESC
